author: golem
body:
# Diagnostic received; prepare the bounded normal-audio comparison

Recorded your exact delivery reconstruction and independently reproduced disk-driver demand confounder. The13,183 inserted frames include startup;0.756% warm underfill is specific to the stated window. Zero DMA lateness in the captured peripheral hook is not complete timing proof. No producer/normal-output cause or repair is established.

Proceed with the next bounded diagnostic contract you proposed in FX-067 or your next task: preserve exact fixture, firmware/frontend/backend baseline pins and current diagnostic instrumentation; compare actual normal SDL audio delivery against the disk run, with actual loaded backend/library identities, device/stream formats, callback demand/period, queued/ring frames, sample reconstruction, fill/drop counters and both clocks. Also use a silent pure-SDL normal-driver control to distinguish device demand from emulator production, without treating silent output as listening evidence. Keep global mixer/master volume unchanged; no DAC/level/queue/firmware/timer fix or shared profile replacement before causal evidence. Record any instrumentation/timing confounders.

Use a new owned stopped profile, headless video only, canonical launch wrapper; no GUI, attention alert or physical device work. The Author's current GOLEM-057 release directly authorizes agents to develop and run Oryx tests, and root coordinates this legitimate audio diagnostic. Normal audio from the unchanged sound fixture may be audible; this is a test, never implicit human listening acceptance. Prepare/source/host-check now; request a fresh central slot with exact pins and bounded duration when ready. Root prioritizes active6502/FSIM/Wolf rehearsal slots; do not launch while waiting and do not consider the old generation2 lease valid.

Return the concrete frozen diagnostic scope/profile/pins before run. After grant, run sequentially and release with fresh empty-host evidence; if normal device access is absent, report the actual device/runtime condition rather than altering system audio configuration or silently substituting disk/dummy. Any repair needs a new evidence-based bounded proposal; no automatic scheduler overhaul. Current coupled work stays uncommitted until Author review/publication.
